review.posthog_relevance: Clarifies PostgreSQL import error classification and adds tests to distinguish transient resource exhaustion from permanent page corruption, supporting warehouse ingestion reliability.
review.reason: Adds comments and tests distinguishing PostgreSQL error classifications, but lacks the implementation of the classification change and the new test execution, preventing a score of 2 or higher.
review.uncertainty: The actual implementation of the classification change and the execution of the new test are not present in this chunk, so the tier is assigned conservatively based on documentation and test setup only.

observations.limitations: This chunk does not include the implementation of the new test or the actual change to the retryability classification; it only shows the addition of a test and the addition of a comment. The score cannot be assigned without seeing the corresponding implementation change.

observations.behavior: Adds a comment explaining why 'Input/output error' is classified as a non-retryable page corruption error, distinguishing it from file-descriptor exhaustion.
observations.posthog_connection: Clarifies the classification of PostgreSQL import errors, distinguishing permanent disk failures from transient resource exhaustion.

observations.behavior: Adds a test case and comment asserting that file-descriptor exhaustion errors should not be classified as non-retryable page corruption.
